hq_location.notes: The company’s contact page explicitly labels its Henderson, Nevada address as its global/USA headquarters. A separate careers page describes Pune as its headquarters, so the company’s own pages conflict; this answer follows the explicit global headquarters listing.

public_docs.notes: The public knowledge base includes many articles for Salesforce, Zoho, standalone, mobile, and other integrations, as well as API documentation.

raised_18mo.notes: The funding profile reports no funding rounds, so there was no round in the 18 months before 2026-11-09.

founded_year.notes: Both company profile sources list 2008 as the founding year.

last_funding.notes: The company funding profile says SMS-Magic has not raised funding rounds and classifies it as unfunded.

launched_6mo.notes: The newest dated blog item located was November 20, 2025; the press/news index’s newest dated announcement was from 2022, and the release-notes index page was dated November 3, 2025. No dated product or major-feature launch within May 9-November 9, 2026 was found.

pricing_page.notes: The official site links to global pricing, and the pricing page presents plans and prices.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 312 employees as of May 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Recent live LinkedIn postings include an SDR - Team Lead position and an Account Executive position at SMS-Magic.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the public product documentation/release notes, blog, privacy policy and available security FAQ; they describe AI features but do not publicly identify the model or model provider.

named_customers.notes: Both names appear on SMS-Magic’s customer success case studies page.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page has open positions and recent company job listings are available, but the current listings located did not include a title matching AI, ML, data science, NLP, LLM, applied/research scientist, or computer vision. Mentions of AI in role descriptions do not qualify.

compliance_certs.notes: The FAQ states that Screen-Magic received ISO 27001 certification in 2017. The privacy policy claims GDPR compliance; GDPR is a regulatory framework rather than a certification. No other requested certification was found on the cited pages.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These systems are named in SMS-Magic’s public documentation as supported products or integrations.

product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes its CRM-connected messaging platform; public documentation lists product integrations and messaging channels.
product_one_liner.value: SMS-Magic provides a CRM-integrated conversational messaging platform that lets businesses use channels such as SMS and WhatsApp to engage customers from systems including Salesforce and Zoho.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A COO appointment found for Vikas Narang was dated September 2025, outside the 12-month window. I could not verify a sufficiently complete team page or another dated C-level/VP join or departure within the window.
